description: Walk detailed billing usage in ascending timestamp order using cursor pagination. Supports complete JSON or upstream CSV pages, defaulting to 10 rows. Pages exceeding 64 KiB fail without returning partial rows or a next cursor. On continuation, send cursor without the original filters; CSV nextCursor values already encode format=csv so a cursor-only follow-up stays on text/csv. This uses /billing/usage-history, never deprecated /billing/usage. ADMIN API key required — inference keys cannot call this endpoint. This endpoint does not accept x402 wallet auth.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. CSV pages return a csv: prefix so continuation stays on text/csv. Cannot be combined with filters or page_size.

end_timestamp.description: Exclusive first-page upper bound, ISO 8601 UTC with Z suffix.

format.description: Defaults to json. Optional on continuation; CSV nextCursor values already stay on CSV.

page_size.description: First-page row count. Defaults to 10. Complete pages larger than 64 KiB are rejected; use smaller pages or narrower timestamp filters.

start_timestamp.description: Inclusive first-page lower bound, ISO 8601 UTC with Z suffix.

name: venice_billing_usage_history
title: Venice Billing Usage History
